article.title: Why the Global South needs an industrial policy: The Thirty-Sixth Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: While capitalism confines the Global South to raw extraction and cheap exports, democratic planning can break dependence, claim technological control, and turn resources into collective economic power.
